Hi Wild Rock Outfitters team,

I was looking through your Backcountry Skiing and Classic Skiing collections, alongside the canoe paddles section, and your shop clearly covers very different seasons under one roof. With winter approaching, ski gear tends to move quickly while paddling stock slows down.
